principle: Doherty Threshold / cache-versioning; returning users must not be stranded on a stale precached shell
problem: STILL FAILING. The SW cache name is 'mm-shell-dev', NOT 'mm-shell-<sha>'. Root cause found in the deployed /sw.js source: `const BUILD_ID = "__BUILD_ID__".startsWith("__") ? "dev" : "__BUILD_ID__";`. The build-time token `__BUILD_ID__` was NEVER substituted during the Vercel build — it still ships the literal string '__BUILD_ID__', so `.startsWith("__")` is true and BUILD_ID falls back to 'dev'. Caches therefore resolve to 'mm-shell-dev' / 'mm-data-dev' on every deploy. The versioning LOGIC is present and correct; only the build-time replacement is unwired. This is the exact returning-user stale-shell bug UX-1505 was meant to kill — it is still live.
fix: Wire the token replacement at build time. Either (a) add a build step / Next.js webpack DefinePlugin or a postbuild script that does `sed -i "s/__BUILD_ID__/$VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA/" public/sw.js` (or templates sw.js from sw.js.template), or (b) generate sw.js via next-pwa / a small generateSW script that injects `process.env.VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA` (fallback `Date.now()`). Verify post-deploy that `caches.keys()` returns `mm-shell-<sha>` and that an old `mm-shell-*` cache is deleted on the SW 'activate' event.

principle: Refactoring UI — design for real content / long strings; Apple HIG truncation
location: /projects · FOCUS panel · 'Painting now' heading subtitle span '· Ultramarines Blue'
problem: At 375 the FOCUS 'Painting now' heading 'Space Marines · Ultramarines Blue' overflows its container — the '· Ultramarines Blue' span extends to right=417 against a 360px clientWidth. The parent has overflowX:hidden so it is hard-CLIPPED (mid-word, no ellipsis), NOT causing page-level horizontal scroll (documentElement scrollWidth==clientWidth==360). It is a cosmetic truncation, not a layout break. Longer real project+scheme names will lose the tail with no ellipsis affordance.
fix: Add text-overflow: ellipsis + min-width:0 + white-space:nowrap (or allow a 2-line clamp) on the subtitle span so long 'Project · Scheme' titles ellipsize gracefully instead of hard-clipping mid-word. Trivial CSS-only change in the FOCUS heading.

principle: WCAG 1.3.1 (programmatic association) — password-manager / AT username association
problem: Chromium logs a VERBOSE DOM advisory on /user: 'Password forms should have (optionally hidden) username fields for accessibility.' Not a runtime error and not blocking, but password managers and AT pair a username field with the password field; absent one, autofill/credential association is degraded.
fix: Add a (visually hidden if needed) username/email input with autocomplete="username" adjacent to the password field, and autocomplete="current-password"/"new-password" on the password input. Cosmetically invisible, improves password-manager + AT behaviour.
